insight: Identify who the 'point of contact' is on your team (the hero that should initiate or get initiated on). Position around this, not as the point of contact yourself, unless that's your designated role.

insight: When close to completing a major item, reduce your farming distance by 1-2 camps. Being close to item timings reduces your effective power level until you finish.

source.title: This is Why You Die Too Much

insight: After Boots of Travel, prioritize a survivability item before farming aggressively. Don't farm multiple camps away from your team without defensive items.

insight: Build Blink Dagger if you're a tanky hero that shouldn't be initiated on. Follow with Black King Bar or similar defensive item to enable Blink usage safely.

source.title: This is Why You Die Too Much

insight: Black King Bar is better than Satanic Yasha against Disruptor since Glimpse and Static Storm ignore most utility items. BKB blocks both abilities.

source.title: This is Why You Die Too Much

insight: Only teleport away from your team when: enemies are dead, their playmaker is visible elsewhere, or you have no cooldowns. Default should be staying near team to enable fights.

source.title: This is Why You Die Too Much

insight: As game goes later (27+ minutes), reduce the frequency of teleporting away from team. Staying five-man ready becomes increasingly critical.

source.title: This is Why You Die Too Much

insight: Let your initiator (Pudge) start fights. Position so you arrive late as cleanup crew. Never position in front of initiators as the point of contact.

source.title: This is Why You Die Too Much

insight: Check teammate items before building similar ones. Heroes with the same role often build similar items. Shivas is an exception due to its active and Blink synergy.

source.title: This is Why You Die Too Much

insight: Use Boots of Travel to farm distant camps while keeping Teleport ready. Walk away from team to farm safely while maintaining ability to reconnect to fights.

source.title: This is Why You Die Too Much

insight: Pushing farming limits teaches you positioning boundaries, but causes unnecessary deaths short-term. Dial back aggression slightly when: close to item timings, heroes are missing, or enemy has catch potential.
